snippet.title: Golden Gloves VR Trailer with Updated Fight Scenes
snippet.description:
We've updated our Golden Gloves VR trailer with video from our latest game upgrades.  

GGVR is available now on the Early Release section of the Oculus Store.
Play, train and compete with Golden Gloves VR.  Building on 100 years of history, we’re proud to bring the most recognizable brand in boxing into the digital world. Train like a fighter in our virtual gym, as you immerse yourself in the most realistic boxing experience you’ll find outside of a brick and mortar facility. Follow a career path, working your way through the ranks to become a Golden Gloves Champion! Developed by Engine Room VR, a gaming company owned and operated by a licensed and certified boxing coach, promoter, and gym owner, Golden Gloves VR is designed to create a realistic boxing experience. 

Trailer Credits:
Aaron Sloan - Creative Director
Mark Bennett - Director of Photography
John Lewis - Camera Operator & Gaffer
Bryce Riedesel - First Camera Assistant
José Vasquez - Key Grip
Thanks to Matt Scrivner
Filmed in Tulsa's Engine Room Boxing Gym & the Virtual World with boxer Luis Ramirez Mendoza
